issues.rule: Stage: Six stations, laid out left to right, visible from t=0 as quiet static shapes
issues.saw: From 0s to 3s the 3D stage is completely empty except for a stray clipped label fragment ('n Ledger') in the top-left corner; the six stations only appear at 4s.
issues.expected: All six stations and their static labels must be rendered and visible in place from t=0 without stray unpositioned DOM overlays in the top-left corner.
issues.fix: Initialize the scene, camera, stations, and first render pass immediately at t=0, and hide or properly position dynamic overlay labels until they are attached to a valid 3D projection.

issues.rule: Scene contract: Bind payment things to their order
issues.saw: Deterministic checks report 3 render_failures for unbound_element_event (elements at indices 6, 8, 10 in snapshot().elements).
issues.expected: Every non-station element recorded in snapshot().elements must be bound to an orderId via naming (`packet:<orderId>`, `refusal:<orderId>`, `coin:<orderId>`, `ledger:<orderId>`) or an explicit `orderId` property.
issues.fix: Ensure every dynamic element pushed to `snapshot().elements` includes the event's `orderId` property and uses one of the allowed bound prefixes (`packet:`, `refusal:`, `coin:`, `ledger:`, `settled:`), or omit purely decorative sub-meshes (like seals/glows) from `snapshot().elements`.

issues.rule: legibility: Read labels and captions at 1280x720 without zooming. Check size, contrast, overlap, and time on screen.
issues.saw: At 25s–37s, the coin label ('1.5 USDC ord_99b70e93...') and the ledger label ('1.5 USDC · 0xd026fed3 ord_99b70e93...') overlap each other, and the ledger label is clipped off the right edge of the 1280x720 viewport.
issues.expected: All labels must remain fully inside the 1280x720 frame without overlapping each other.
issues.fix: Clamp label horizontal screen positions to stay within viewport margins (e.g. `Math.min(window.innerWidth - width/2 - 16, x)`), and stagger vertical offsets for the merchant coin label vs. the chain ledger label so they do not collide.
